instrument.name: Timed 25-Foot Walk
instrument.construct: quantitative lower-extremity mobility / walking speed performance in multiple sclerosis
instrument.score: mean seconds of two valid trials

rmd.key_description: Average of two trials; walk 25 feet as quickly and safely as possible; second trial is administered immediately; assistive devices may be used and should be documented.

msfc_context.manual_variant_note: The MSFC manual includes additional standardized administration/discontinue rules. Rawafid does not mirror the manual or claim that this operational sheet replaces formal MSFC administration materials.

measurement_properties.interpretation: Reference values come from specific samples reported by RMD and are not universal diagnostic cutoffs.

rights.basis: RMD Cost=Free is not treated as a reproduction license. Rawafid provides an original timing/QC worksheet and paraphrased procedural summary based on RMD and links to formal MSFC materials; it does not mirror the MSFC record form, manual layout, scripted wording, or training content.

arabic.rawafid_language_status: Original Arabic operational timing sheet; not represented as an official Arabic MSFC/T25FW translation.
